clues.it: Sergio era nella 14ª colonna, a nord di Vito e nell'Hangar.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 14th column, north of Vito and in the Hangar.

clues.it: Irene era nella 12ª colonna e accanto a una criocapsula o a una grata.
clues.en: Irene was in the 12th column and beside a cryopod or a floor grate.

clues.it: Rosa era accanto a una perdita di refrigerante e a nord di Vito.
clues.en: Rosa was beside a coolant spill and north of Vito.

clues.it: Fabio era l'unica persona su una grata e a nord di Nino.
clues.en: Fabio was the only person on a floor grate and north of Nino.

clues.it: Carla era nella 10ª colonna e accanto a una vasca idroponica, ma non era accanto a una poltrona.
clues.en: Carla was in the 10th column and beside a hydroponic tank, but was not beside a flight seat.

clues.it: Tea era nella 6ª riga, a ovest di Elena e sul Ponte di Comando.
clues.en: Tea was in the 6th row, west of Elena and on the Command Deck.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a una criocapsula, ma non era accanto a una grata.
clues.en: Bruno was beside a cryopod, but was not beside a floor grate.

clues.it: Olga era accanto a un'antenna e nella stessa stanza di Elena.
clues.en: Olga was beside an antenna and in the same room as Elena.

clues.it: Elena era nella 9ª colonna, nella 9ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Tea.
clues.en: Elena was in the 9th column, in the 9th row and in the same room as Tea.

clues.it: Nino era nella 10ª riga e a ovest di Olga.
clues.en: Nino was in the 10th row and west of Olga.

clues.it: Ugo era accanto a una criocapsula o a un reattore e a una poltrona.
clues.en: Ugo was beside a cryopod or a reactor and a flight seat.

clues.it: Luca era nella 8ª colonna e nella 12ª riga, ma non era accanto a un droide.
clues.en: Luca was in the 8th column and in the 12th row, but was not beside a droid.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 4ª colonna e nella 14ª riga, ma non era accanto a un serbatoio.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 4th column and in the 14th row, but was not beside a fuel tank.
